# U.S. Healthcare Sector Analysis. The Healthcare industry is up 5.0% in the last week, with Johnson & Johnson up 3.3%. This takes the industry's 12 month performance to a gain of 24%. ## Sector Valuation and Performance. * What is the health care sector? # Health care sector: Investing in stocks that help keep you well. Regardless of your age, condition, or financial situation, you likely spend some money on products and services to maintain your health, whether it’s a few bucks at the pharmacy or a major hospital visit. * Health care is prominent within the S&P 500; it’s one of the largest segments of the index’s 11 sectors. * Many health care industries are noncyclical, but some (like biotechnology) operate in emerging and speculative fields. Knowing which industries in the sector to invest in and when can help you position your portfolio for growth, mitigate market risk, and take advantage of both stable and speculative opportunities in the market. So if you’re thinking of adding health care stocks to your portfolio, get to know the industries and companies well, make sure they match your investment strategy, and pay attention to the regulatory and health-related trends affecting the sector.
